mapper.sql: (SELECT r.file_id FROM r_file r JOIN t_file tf ON tf.file_id = r.file_id AND tf.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE r.map_key = h.hobby_id AND r.file_loc = 'HOBBY' ORDER BY r.ordr LIMIT 1)
mapper.select: SELECT h.hobby_id::TEXT AS row_id, h.hobby_nm, h.summary, h.difficulty_cd, h.equipment, h.est_cost, h.bbsinfo_id, h.sort_ordr, dc.code_nm AS difficulty_nm, bi.bbsinfo_nm, AS thumb_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_bbs b WHERE b.bbsinfo_id = h.bbsinfo_id AND b.use_yn = 'Y' AND b.p_bbs_id = 0) AS post_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user_hobby uh WHERE uh.hobby_id = h.hobby_id AND uh.use_yn = 'Y') AS member_cnt FROM t_hobby h LEFT JOIN t_code dc ON dc.code_id = h.difficulty_cd AND dc.p_code_id = 'HOBBYLV00' LEFT JOIN t_bbsinfo bi ON bi.bbsinfo_id = h.bbsinfo_id WHERE h.use_yn = 'Y' AND h.hobby_nm LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' ORDER BY h.sort_ordr, h.hobby_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_hobby WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND bbsinfo_id = #{bbsinfoId}::integer
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_hobby h WHERE h.use_yn = 'Y' AND h.hobby_nm LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'

SELECT h.hobby_id::TEXT AS row_id, h.hobby_nm, h.summary, h.intro, h.guide, h.difficulty_cd, h.equipment, h.est_cost, h.bbsinfo_id, h.sort_ordr, dc.code_nm AS difficulty_nm, bi.bbsinfo_nm, AS thumb_id FROM t_hobby h LEFT JOIN t_code dc ON dc.code_id = h.difficulty_cd AND dc.p_code_id = 'HOBBYLV00' LEFT JOIN t_bbsinfo bi ON bi.bbsinfo_id = h.bbsinfo_id WHERE h.hobby_id = #{rowId}::integer AND h.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_hobby (hobby_nm, summary, intro, guide, difficulty_cd, equipment, est_cost, bbsinfo_id, sort_ordr, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{hobbyNm}, NULLIF(#{summary}, ''), #{intro}, #{guide}, NULLIF(#{difficultyCd}, ''), NULLIF(#{equipment}, ''), NULLIF(#{estCost}, ''), NULLIF(#{bbsinfoId}, '')::integer, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{sortOrdr}, '')::integer, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_ordr), 0) + 1 FROM t_hobby WHERE use_yn = 'Y')), 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_hobby SET hobby_nm = #{hobbyNm}, summary = NULLIF(#{summary}, ''), intro = #{intro}, guide = #{guide}, difficulty_cd = NULLIF(#{difficultyCd}, ''), equipment = NULLIF(#{equipment}, ''), est_cost = NULLIF(#{estCost}, ''), bbsinfo_id = NULLIF(#{bbsinfoId}, '')::integer, sort_ordr = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{sortOrdr}, '')::integer, 0), upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE hobby_id = #{rowId}::integer
UPDATE t_hobby SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE hobby_id = #{rowId}::integer
